principles: Student/community posts establish that a claim was made, not universal truth.
Visual artifacts establish visible features but not voluntariness or coercion by themselves.
Police/criminal peer-harassment cases are not automatically classified as fresher ragging.
Evidence gaps are published explicitly rather than filled by inference.
